intro: Eldreth Row comprises the soaring, ruined outer halls forming the western entrance to Dire Maul in Feralas. Once a grand threshold of ancient Eldre'Thalas, the area is now choked with overgrowth and fiercely patrolled by Gordunni ogres.

p: Standing as the outermost perimeter of ancient Eldre'Thalas, Eldreth Row is an imposing avenue of high-arched elven architecture that sits just outside the deeper quarters and the Broken Commons. Centuries of neglect have cracked its stonework, allowing the creeping flora of Feralas to reclaim its colonnades. Today, the pristine majesty of the Highborne has been replaced by the crude dominance of the Gordunni ogres, who use the halls as an outer staging ground, guarding the paths leading east toward the Warpwood Quarter and west past the Dire Pool.
